export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/45.1.0
LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID --default "")
LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE --default "")
LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER --default "")
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER
export LARCH_QUIET_BREADCRUMBS=1

EXPECTED_SESSION_ID=$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-id" 2>/dev/null || true)
CLONE_TAG_FULL=larch9

# Reset stall tracking for resume
sed -i '' 's/^STALL_TRACKING=true$/STALL_TRACKING=false/' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh"
sed -i '' 's/^STALL_STEP=.*$/STALL_STEP=/' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh"
echo "Stall cleared, re-invoking ship-pr"

mkdir -p "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs"
_launch_id="ship-pr3.$$"
export LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.ndjson"
: > "$LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM"
export LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.done.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_STATUS_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.status.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_QUIET_LOG_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.quiet.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.surfaced.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.pid.XXXXXX")"
touch "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL" "$LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE"

# Tool JSON: run_in_background: true
# Background pair required: see BASH_AUTHORING.md §4
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/ship-pr.sh" \
  --state-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" \
  --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" \
  --merge "true" \
  --draft "false" \
  --forked "false" \
  --branch-name "sergey-zhupanov/implementing-when-design-asks-to-approve-3035" \
  --expected-session-id "$EXPECTED_SESSION_ID" \
  --expected-tmpdir-basename-prefix "claude-implement-${CLONE_TAG_FULL}-" \
  --issue-number "3035" \
  --manifest-path "" \
  --run-id "E0F6B1E7-CA9B-49D2-B113-2E0E501D2835" \
  --tool-label "codex" \
  --no-admin-fallback "false" \
  --no-logs-commit "false" \
  --repo "character-ai/larch" \
  --resume-phase "ci-initial" &
SHIP_PR_PID=$!

monitor_rc=0
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/breadcrumb-monitor.sh" \
  --stream "$LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM" \
  --done-sentinel "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL" \
  --status-file "$LARCH_STATUS_FILE" \
  --quiet-log "$LARCH_QUIET_LOG_FILE" \
  --surfaced-sentinel "$LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE" \
  --paired-pid-file "$LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE" \
  || monitor_rc=$?

if [ "$monitor_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  writer_rc=0
  wait "$SHIP_PR_PID" || writer_rc=$?
  exit "$writer_rc"
else
  wait "$SHIP_PR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit "$monitor_rc"
fi

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/45.1.0

_stream=$(ls -t "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr3.*.ndjson 2>/dev/null | head -1)
_done=$(ls -t "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr3.*.done.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
_status=$(ls -t "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr3.*.status.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
_quiet=$(ls -t "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr3.*.quiet.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
_surfaced=$(ls -t "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr3.*.surfaced.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
_pid=$(ls -t "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr3.*.pid.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)

"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/breadcrumb-monitor.sh" \
  --stream "$_stream" \
  --done-sentinel "$_done" \
  --status-file "$_status" \
  --quiet-log "$_quiet" \
  --surfaced-sentinel "$_surfaced" \
  --paired-pid-file "$_pid"
echo "MONITOR_RC=$?"

export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
# Wait for CI + merge to complete
_wait=0
while [ $_wait -lt 1800 ]; do
  _phase=$(grep '^PHASE=' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
  _ci=$(grep '^CI_PASSED=' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
  _closed=$(grep '^PR_CLOSED=' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
  _stall=$(grep '^STALL_TRACKING=' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
  echo "${_wait}s: PHASE=$_phase CI_PASSED=$_ci PR_CLOSED=$_closed STALL=$_stall"
  [ "$_phase" = "done" ] || [ "$_phase" = "postmerge" ] && echo "DONE!" && break
  [ "$_stall" = "true" ] && echo "STALLED again!" && break
  sleep 30
  _wait=$((_wait + 30))
done
